race.title: All-Weather Championship Is Back Handicap
race.verdict: MACANUDO has a far more solid profile than most of these and a reproduction of recent efforts looks sure to see him go well. Little Jaybee is another with recent winning form to her name so she's a threat, as too is Ten Cuidado if in the same form as 10 days ago. MACANUDO (IRE) LITTLE JAYBEE TEN CUIDADO (IRE)
